This matter is taken up through Hybrid arrangement (video conferencing/physical mode).
Learned counsel for opp. party nos.3 to 5 has filed an affidavit in Court today, which is taken on record.
Let a copy of the affidavit be served on the learned counsel for the petitioner so also learned counsel for the State.

The petitioner, Dhruba Charan Kumbhar has filed this writ petition seeking for a direction to the Dhruba Charan Kumbhar vs State Of Odisha on 10 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/192300930/

It appears that the opp. party no.5 earlier approached this Court in W.P.(C) No.27355 of 2022 and this Court vide order dated 22.11.2022 disposed of the same directing the opp. party no.4 (Department of Energy, Govt. of Odisha) to consider the representation filed by the petitioners in the said case and pass appropriate order in accordance with law within a period of four weeks from the date of production of certified copy of this order.

In pursuance of the order passed by this Court, it appears that the Govt. of Odisha, Energy Department vide order dated 16.01.2023 found that there is no illegality or impropriety in the order passed by the Collector, Bolangir, opp. party no.2 and accordingly directed the C.E.O., TPWODL to take steps to purchase/acquire the land in the name of Department of Energy, Govt. of Odisha from rightful/recorded owner of the land, with necessary approval from all concerned, on payment of compensation as per the provisions laid down in the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 and the payment towards such compensation shall be governed under the respective Vesting Order of the Commission (OERC).
It further appears that a Committee was formed, which is called "District Compensation Advisory Committee" in which the Addl. District Magistrate, Balangir, the Sub-Collector, Patnagarh, the D.F.O., Balangir, the Tahasildar, Khaprakhol, the Superintending Engineer, TPWODL, Electrical Circle, Balangir, the Sub- Registrar, Patnagarh and the Land Acquisition Officer, Balangir were the members of the Committee and accordingly, the market value of the land was determined.
In pursuance of such decision taken in the meeting, the Land Acquisition Officer, Collectorate,
Balangir vide letter dated 29.08.2024, which is addressed to the Superintending Engineer,
TPWODL, Electrical, Circle, Balangir requested to deposit 2 % of contingent amount worth Rs.2,09,462/- (rupees two lakhs nine thousand four hundred sixty two) in favour of the Land Acquisition Officer, Collectorate, Balangir at the earliest through A/c payee cheque.
It is the contention of the learned counsel for the petitioner that such amount has not yet been deposited for which, no progress could be made.
After hearing learned counsel for the respective parties, we direct the opp. party nos.4 and 5 to make necessary deposit within a week.
List this matter on 23.12.2024.
Learned counsel for the opp. party nos.4 and 5 shall produce the necessary documents showing compliance of this order.
